audit_status.review_note: Draft restored English of 2 Chronicles 31 aligned to supplied Hebrew; retains divine name YHWH and preserves name-variant and administrative details for witness review.

verses.restored: And when all this was completed, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah; they broke the standing-stones, cut down the asherim, and broke down the high places and the altars from all Judah and Benjamin, even in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they utterly destroyed them. Then all the children of Israel returned, each to his possession, into their cities.

familiar.text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

verses.restored: Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites according to their divisions, each man according to his service—priests and Levites for olah (burnt offerings) and for shelamim (peace/thank offerings), to minister and to give thanks and to praise at the gateways of the tents of YHWH.

familiar.text: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

verses.restored: He appointed also the king’s minah (portion) from his wealth for the burnt offerings—to present for the morning and evening olot, for the sabbaths and the new moons and the appointed feasts, as written in the law of YHWH.

familiar.text: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD.

verses.restored: Moreover he commanded the people who dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion for the priests and the Levites, that they might be strengthened in the law of YHWH.

familiar.text: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

familiar.text: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

verses.restored: And the children of Israel and of Judah who dwelt in the cities of Judah also brought the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things, consecrated to YHWH their God; and they laid them by heaps.

familiar.text: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.

familiar.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

familiar.text: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

verses.restored: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, saying: 'From the time the offerings began to be brought into the house of YHWH we have had enough and have been filled, and have left much; for YHWH has blessed His people; and that which is left is this great store.'

familiar.text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

translation_notes: Rendered Hebrew יהוה as YHWH throughout. Kept Israelite cultic terms (e.g., asherim, olah, minah) as transliterations with glosses where useful.
Preserved proper-name spellings from the supplied Hebrew; flagged variant orthographies (e.g., כונניהו/כָּנַנְיָהוּ) for witness audit.
safety_note: Contains unsanitized religiously-motivated destruction and institutional coercion; preserved as in source.
